name: Wild Game
overview: Set against an isolated and rugged backdrop, a group of men find themselves caught in a game of pursuit and physical endurance. Taking place deep within a dense forest, the plot explores the tension between predator and prey, where the limits of effort and desire are tested amidst the wilderness. Driven by a climate of suspense and action, the protagonists must navigate their most primal instincts while striving for survival in an environment where no one can outrun the stakes forever.
